answer: Escrowed reputation maturity: each new identity's reputation accrues only against a slowly released escrow the agent funds upfront, so early withdrawal forfeits unearned gains. An attacker farming many sockpuppets must pre-fund every one and wait out the maturity curve, turning each fake into a slow lotus of sunk capital. Crossing the maturity summit requires sustained honest activity before rewards unlock, so a swarm's aggregate float scales linearly with identity count. The operator thus pays the full orchard of escrows to sustain even a thin sybil fleet.
